children: The central bank of Norway left its key policy interest rate steady at 4.5% at its November 2026 meeting, in line with market expectations, following a 25bps rate hike in the previous meeting in September. “Inflation is too high.

It will likely be necessary to keep the policy rate elevated for a time, and we are prepared to raise the policy rate if needed to bring inflation down to target within a reasonable time horizon”, says Governor Ida Wolden Bache.
Policymakers also added that inflation remains markedly above target, and the rapid rise in business costs in recent years will likely contribute to keeping inflation elevated ahead.
The Committee has not received information indicating that the outlook for the Norwegian economy has changed materially since its monetary policy meeting in September.

title: Norges Bank Leaves Key Rate Steady as Expected
